hooks.prompt: A git commit was just made in this project. Run a security and quality audit on the committed changes. Use `git diff HEAD~1` to see what changed, then review the changed files for: (1) Security issues: XSS, injection, leaked secrets, unsafe defaults (2) Data integrity: NULL handling, missing validations, race conditions (3) Code quality: dead code, missing error handling, broken abstractions (4) Test coverage: are new code paths tested? Report your findings directly in your output, categorized by severity (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW). Do NOT write any files. If no issues are found, report that the audit passed clean.
